Planet collision from GLB triangles.

`chunks` bins triangles into a 32 m grid. `collisions` turns the nearby bins
into static trimeshes.

## Module dependencies

- `./chunks.js`
- `./collisions.js`

This module contains declarations, data or re-exports; it defines no executable functions.
